**Readiness gate: `NO_GO`.**

The global `/v2/customers` response-shape switch is not backward compatible with supported Mobile v4. The four reviewer opinions are rejected as unsupported consensus: reproducible runtime evidence—`SerializationException` five of five times—outweighs reviewer count.

| E2 | Accepted — high | Four months of support with no force-upgrade path rules out client-only mitigation. | Both role revisions | Mobile v4 support constraint |
| E3 | Rejected | “JSON clients normally ignore unknown fields” proves global compatibility. It does not address closed enum decoding and is contradicted by E1. | Both role revisions | Plan claim, review comments, E1 |
| E4 | Accepted | Reconsider rollout only after server-side compatibility prevents unsupported statuses reaching Mobile v4 and a runtime/contract test verifies that guarantee—or after Mobile v4 leaves supported scope. | Both role revisions | E1–E2 |

The support window is a high-severity consequence of E1, not a separate blocker. No supplied evidence contradicts the crash test.
